what_approval_commits_to: By approving the cover gate, the approver confirms that the cover wrap at cover-pdf hash sha256:e87c241a... is an original full-bleed design appropriate for the senior-large-print audience, that its spine width (0.4549in) and wrap size (17.7049x11.25in) are correct for the 202-page interior on white paper as verified by the cover-proof PASS, and that the title is legible at channel thumbnail size. Approval binds to the exact cover-pdf and cover-proof hashes listed in this packet. It does NOT clear font commercial-use rights, cover-art originality attestation, or AI-assistance disclosure (those are decided at the compliance gate), and it does NOT by itself make the project release-ready given the state mismatch noted under risks.
